C08-M08-L03-F1.title: Containment options: what each one stops, keeps, costs and signals
C08-M08-L03-F1.caption: Six common containment actions rated on stopping the attacker, keeping evidence, business impact and how strongly they alert the attacker.
C08-M08-L03-F1.alt: Table with five columns: Action, Stops attacker, Keeps evidence, Business impact, Tip-off signal. Row 1, green: EDR network isolation; high (that host); high (host stays on); medium; noticeable. Row 2, green: Block domain / IP; partial; high; low; low. Row 3, green: Disable + revoke sessions; high (credentials); high; medium; strong. Row 4, orange: Disable persistence account; partial (way back in); high (account kept); low; medium. Row 5, red: Power off; high; low (memory lost); high; strong. Row 6, red: Wipe and reimage; high (that host); very low; high; strong.
C08-M08-L03-F1.note: No single action wins on every column: combine the green rows, and time the signalling actions together.

C08-M08-L03-F2.title: One containment decision: recommend, approve, execute, verify
C08-M08-L03-F2.caption: The analyst recommends and verifies, the incident lead decides, the business owner provides the workaround and operations teams execute.
C08-M08-L03-F2.alt: Sequence diagram with four lanes, left to right: SOC analyst (orange), Incident lead (dark), Business owner (blue, head of finance), IT ops / identity (green). 1, analyst to incident lead: Recommendation: actions, order, impact. 2, incident lead to business owner: Impact: payments approver offline. 3, dashed reply from business owner to incident lead: Workaround: deputy approves payments. 4, dashed, incident lead to analyst: Approved: execute together. 5, incident lead to IT ops / identity: Execute: isolate, block, disable, revoke. 6, dashed, IT ops / identity to analyst: Done + time of each action. 7, analyst to incident lead: Verified: no beacon, no sign-ins.
C08-M08-L03-F2.note: Every arrow is recorded with a UTC time in the incident log.
